test_args.rationale: minimum cycle: NIST atomic spectra, offline (bundled seed), single world

factory_lowlevel.daemon.run_multi_world_factory_cycle() completes a single cycle in well under a second offline.

Pipeline visual updates as the cycle runs (live polling).
Life forms stream renders in the 'life forms - real trace outputs' panel.
Recent runs panel commits a new row to project_telemetry/low_level_factory_sessions.jsonl after each cycle.
